name: code-pet
description: A pixel pet in the side panel: a blob, corgi, shiba, cat or bunny in several coats, named by you. It eats passing tests, cheers commits, sulks at failures and grows up as you code; kept across sessions.

species.title: Pet kind
species.description: bit (the colour-changing blob), corgi, shiba, cat or bunny. "picked" keeps what you chose in the pet's panel or with /pet adopt.

coat.title: Coat
coat.description: corgi: tricolor, red, sable · shiba: red, black-tan, cream · cat: orange, black, gray, calico · bunny: white, brown, gray. A coat the kind doesn't have falls back to its first. "picked" keeps your choice in the panel.

name.title: Pet name
name.description: Up to 16 characters. Empty keeps the name you gave it in the panel or with /pet name.
